items.reason: A lower-strength retinol is a gentle way to start a night routine aimed at the look of fine lines.
A simple ceramide moisturizer helps support a comfortable, hydrated look while skin gets used to retinol.
Retinol makes skin more sun-sensitive, so a daily mineral SPF 50 is essential alongside it.

response.routine_note: Apply the retinol at night to dry skin, 2 nights a week at first, then add nights slowly as skin stays comfortable, following with the moisturizer. Use the SPF every morning, and pause the retinol if skin feels stinging or very dry.
